{{Short description|None}}

The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (FBI) operates 55 '''field offices''' in major cities throughout the [[United States]] and [[Puerto Rico]]. Many of these offices are further subdivided into smaller resident agencies that have jurisdiction over a specific area. These resident agencies are considered to be part of the primary field offices. FBI headquarters, located in [[Washington, D.C.]], controls the flow of the agents and support staff that work out of the field offices across the country. Each field office is overseen by a [[Special Agent in Charge]] (SAC), except those located in [[Los Angeles]], [[New York City]], and [[Washington, D.C.]], which due to their large size, are each managed by an Assistant Director in Charge (ADIC), assisted by SACs responsible for specific programs or departments. The FBI also has offices overseas otherwise known as legal attachés. The FBI international offices are usually in American embassies.

== Alabama ==
* '''[[Birmingham, Alabama|Birmingham]]''': Serves the counties of [[Bibb County, Alabama|Bibb]], [[DeKalb County, Alabama|DeKalb]], [[Lauderdale County, Alabama|Lauderdale]], [[St. Clair County, Alabama|St. Clair]], [[Blount County, Alabama|Blount]], [[Etowah County, Alabama|Etowah]], [[Lawrence County, Alabama|Lawrence]], [[Shelby County, Alabama|Shelby]], [[Calhoun County, Alabama|Calhoun]], [[Fayette County, Alabama|Fayette]], [[Limestone County, Alabama|Limestone]], [[Sumter County, Alabama|Sumter]], [[Cherokee County, Alabama|Cherokee]], [[Franklin County, Alabama|Franklin]], [[Madison County, Alabama|Madison]], [[Talladega County, Alabama|Talladega]], [[Clay County, Alabama|Clay]], [[Greene County, Alabama|Greene]], [[Marion County, Alabama|Marion]], [[Tuscaloosa County, Alabama|Tuscaloosa]], [[Cleburne County, Alabama|Cleburne]], [[Jackson County, Alabama|Jackson]], [[Marshall County, Alabama|Marshall]], [[Walker County, Alabama|Walker]], [[Colbert County, Alabama|Colbert]], [[Jefferson County, Alabama|Jefferson]], [[Morgan County, Alabama|Morgan]], [[Winston County, Alabama|Winston]], [[Cullman County, Alabama|Cullman]], [[Lamar County, Alabama|Lamar]] and [[Pickens County, Alabama|Pickens]].  Four Resident Agencies in [[Florence, Alabama|Florence]], [[Gadsden, Alabama|Gadsden]], [[Huntsville, Alabama|Huntsville]] and [[Tuscaloosa, Alabama|Tuscaloosa]].
* '''[[Mobile, Alabama|Mobile]]''': Serves the counties of [[Autauga County, Alabama|Autauga]], [[Coffee County, Alabama|Coffee]], [[Geneva County, Alabama|Geneva]], [[Monroe County, Alabama|Monroe]], [[Baldwin County, Alabama|Baldwin]], [[Conecuh County, Alabama|Conecuh]], [[Hale County, Alabama|Hale]], [[Montgomery County, Alabama|Montgomery]], [[Barbour County, Alabama|Barbour]], [[Coosa County, Alabama|Coosa]], [[Henry County, Alabama|Henry]], [[Perry County, Alabama|Perry]], [[Bullock County, Alabama|Bullock]], [[Covington County, Alabama|Covington]], [[Houston County, Alabama|Houston]], [[Pike County, Alabama|Pike]], [[Butler County, Alabama|Butler]], [[Crenshaw County, Alabama|Crenshaw]], [[Lee County, Alabama|Lee]], [[Randolph County, Alabama|Randolph]], [[Chambers County, Alabama|Chambers]], [[Dale County, Alabama|Dale]], [[Lowndes County, Alabama|Lowndes]], [[Russell County, Alabama|Russell]], [[Chilton County, Alabama|Chilton]], [[Dallas County, Alabama|Dallas]], [[Macon County, Alabama|Macon]], [[Tallapoosa County, Alabama|Tallapoosa]], [[Choctaw County, Alabama|Choctaw]], [[Elmore County, Alabama|Elmore]], [[Marengo County, Alabama|Marengo]], [[Washington County, Alabama|Washington]], [[Clarke County, Alabama|Clarke]], [[Escambia County, Alabama|Escambia]], [[Mobile County, Alabama|Mobile]] and [[Wilcox County, Alabama|Wilcox]]. Resident Agencies in [[Auburn, Alabama|Auburn]], [[Dothan, Alabama|Dothan]], [[Monroeville, Alabama|Monroeville]], [[Montgomery, Alabama|Montgomery]], and [[Selma, Alabama|Selma]].

== Alaska ==
* '''[[Anchorage, Alaska|Anchorage]]''': Entire state. Resident Agencies in [[Fairbanks, Alaska|Fairbanks]] and [[Juneau, Alaska|Juneau]].

== Arizona ==
* '''[[Phoenix, Arizona|Phoenix]]''': Entire State. Resident agencies in [[Flagstaff, Arizona|Flagstaff]], [[Lake Havasu City, Arizona|Lake Havasu City]], [[Lakeside, Arizona|Lakeside]], [[Sierra Vista, Arizona|Sierra Vista]], [[Tucson, Arizona|Tucson]], and [[Yuma, Arizona|Yuma]].

== Arkansas ==
* '''[[Little Rock, Arkansas|Little Rock]]''': Entire state. Resident agencies in [[El Dorado, Arkansas|El Dorado]], [[Fayetteville, Arkansas|Fayetteville]], [[Fort Smith, Arkansas|Fort Smith]], [[Hot Springs, Arkansas|Hot Springs]], [[Jonesboro, Arkansas|Jonesboro]], [[Marion, Arkansas|Marion]], [[Pine Bluff, Arkansas|Pine Bluff]] and [[Texarkana, Arkansas|Texarkana]].

== California ==
* '''[[Los Angeles]]''': Serves the counties of [[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles]], [[Orange County, California|Orange]], [[San Bernardino County, California|San Bernardino]], [[San Luis Obispo County, California|San Luis Obispo]], [[Santa Barbara County, California|Santa Barbara]], [[Riverside County, California|Riverside]], and [[Ventura County, California|Ventura]].  Resident Agencies in [[Lancaster, California|Lancaster]], [[Los Angeles International Airport|LAX]], [[Long Beach, California|Long Beach]], [[Orange, California|Orange]], [[Palm Springs, California|Palm Springs]], [[Riverside, California|Riverside]], [[Santa Maria, California|Santa Maria]], [[Ventura, California|Ventura]], [[Victorville, California|Victorville]] and [[West Covina, California|West Covina]]. Located inside the [[Wilshire Federal Building]].
* '''[[Sacramento, California|Sacramento]]''': Serves [[Yosemite National Park]] and the counties of [[Alpine County, California|Alpine]], [[Amador County, California|Amador]], [[Butte County, California|Butte]], [[Calaveras County, California|Calaveras]], [[Colusa County, California|Colusa]], [[El Dorado County, California|El Dorado]], [[Fresno County, California|Fresno]], [[Glenn County, California|Glenn]], [[Inyo County, California|Inyo]], [[Kern County, California|Kern]], [[Kings County, California|Kings]], [[Lassen County, California|Lassen]], [[Madera County, California|Madera]], [[Merced County, California|Merced]], [[Mariposa County, California|Mariposa]], [[Modoc County, California|Modoc]], [[Mono County, California|Mono]], [[Nevada County, California|Nevada]], [[Placer County, California|Placer]], [[Plumas County, California|Plumas]], [[Sacramento County, California|Sacramento]], [[San Joaquin County, California|San Joaquin]], [[Shasta County, California|Shasta]], [[Sierra County, California|Sierra]], [[Siskiyou County, California|Siskiyou]], [[Solano County, California|Solano]], [[Stanislaus County, California|Stanislaus]], [[Sutter County, California|Sutter]], [[Tehama County, California|Tehama]], [[Trinity County, California|Trinity]], [[Tulare County, California|Tulare]], [[Tuolumne County, California|Tuolumne]], [[Yolo County, California|Yolo]], and [[Yuba County, California|Yuba]].  Resident agencies in [[Bakersfield, California|Bakersfield]], [[Chico, California|Chico]], [[Fairfield, California|Fairfield]], [[Fresno, California|Fresno]],  [[Redding, California|Redding]], [[South Lake Tahoe, California|South Lake Tahoe]], and [[Stockton, California|Stockton]]
* '''[[San Diego]]''': Serves the counties of [[Imperial County, California|Imperial]] and [[San Diego County, California|San Diego]].  Resident agencies in [[Imperial, California|Imperial]] and [[North County (San Diego area)|North County]].
* '''[[San Francisco]]''': Serves the counties of: [[Alameda County, California|Alameda]], [[Contra Costa County, California|Contra Costa]], [[Del Norte County, California|Del Norte]], [[Humboldt County, California|Humboldt]], [[Lake County, California|Lake]], [[Marin County, California|Marin]], [[Mendocino County, California|Mendocino]], [[Monterey County, California|Monterey]], [[Napa County, California|Napa]], [[San Benito County, California|San Benito]], [[San Francisco]], [[Santa Clara County, California|Santa Clara]], [[Santa Cruz County, California|Santa Cruz]], [[San Mateo County, California|San Mateo]] and [[Sonoma County, California|Sonoma]].  Resident agencies in [[Concord, California|Concord]], [[Fortuna, California|Fortuna]], [[Monterey County, California|Monterey Bay]], [[Oakland, California|Oakland]], [[Palo Alto, California|Palo Alto]], [[San Jose, California|San Jose]] and [[Santa Rosa, California|Santa Rosa]].

== Colorado ==
* '''[[Denver]]''': Serves all counties and the state of [[Wyoming]].  Resident agencies in [[Casper, Wyoming|Casper]], [[Cheyenne, Wyoming|Cheyenne]], [[Colorado Springs, Colorado|Colorado Springs]], [[Durango, Colorado|Durango]], [[Fort Collins, Colorado|Fort Collins]], [[Glenwood Springs, Colorado|Glenwood Springs]], [[Grand Junction, Colorado|Grand Junction]], [[Jackson, Wyoming|Jackson Hole]], [[Lander, Wyoming|Lander]] and [[Pueblo, Colorado|Pueblo]].

== Connecticut ==
* '''[[New Haven, Connecticut|New Haven]]''': Entire state.  Resident agencies in [[Bridgeport, Connecticut|Bridgeport]], [[Meriden, Connecticut|Meriden]] and [[New London, Connecticut|New London]].

== Georgia ==
* '''[[Atlanta]]''' ([[DeKalb County, Georgia|DeKalb County]]): Entire state.  Resident agencies in [[Albany, Georgia|Albany]], [[Athens, Georgia|Athens]], [[Augusta, Georgia|Augusta]], [[Brunswick, Georgia|Brunswick]], [[Columbus, Georgia|Columbus]], [[Dalton, Georgia|Dalton]], [[Gainesville, Georgia|Gainesville]], [[Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport]], [[Macon, Georgia|Macon]], [[Rome, Georgia|Rome]], [[Savannah, Georgia|Savannah]], [[Statesboro, Georgia|Statesboro]], [[Thomasville, Georgia|Thomasville]] and [[Valdosta, Georgia|Valdosta]].

The field office's current location, on the grounds of [[Mercer University]] Atlanta Campus, opened in 2017.<ref>{{cite press release |url=https://www.fbi.gov/contact-us/field-offices/atlanta/news/press-releases/fbi-atlanta-hosts-ribbon-cutting-ceremony-at-its-new-mercer-atlanta-location|title=FBI Atlanta Hosts Ribbon Cutting Ceremony at Its New Mercer Atlanta Location|publisher=[[Federal Bureau of Investigation]]|date=2017-10-12|accessdate=2018-09-23}}</ref> The office was previously located in [[Chamblee, Georgia|Chamblee]].<ref>"[https://www.fbi.gov/atlanta Atlanta Division]". [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]]. Retrieved on June 9, 2015. "2635 Century Parkway N.E., Suite 400 Atlanta, GA 30345".</ref><ref>"[http://www.chambleega.com/DocumentCenter/View/452 City of Chamblee Street Map]" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150619030543/http://www.chambleega.com/DocumentCenter/View/452 Archive]). City of Chamblee. Retrieved on June 9, 2015.</ref>

== Hawaii ==
* '''[[Honolulu]]''' ([[Kapolei, Hawaii|Kapolei]]): Serves all counties, the US territories of [[American Samoa]], and [[Guam]], and the [[Northern Marianas]].  Resident agencies in [[Kona District, Hawaii|Kona]], [[Mongmong-Toto-Maite, Guam|Mongmong-Toto-Maite]], [[Saipan]], [[Wailuku, Hawaii|Wailuku]], and [[Pago Pago]].

* '''[[Albany, New York|Albany]]''': Serves all of [[Vermont]] and the New York Counties of Albany, Broome, Cayuga, Chenango, Clinton, Columbia, Cortland, Delaware, Essex, Franklin, Fulton, Greene, Hamilton, Herkimer, Jefferson, Lewis, Madison, Montgomery, Oneida, Onondaga, Oswego, Otsego, Rensselaer, Saratoga, Schenectady, Schoharie, St. Lawrence, Tioga, Tompkins, Ulster, Warren and Washington. * '''[[New York City]]''' ([[Jacob K. Javits Federal Building]]): Serves the City of New York (counties of the Bronx, New York, Richmond, Queens & Kings) and the counties of Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Sullivan and Westchester. Kennedy International Airport|JFK Airport]], [[Melville, New York|Melville]] and [[Rye, New York|Rye]] (formerly located in [[White Plains, New York|White Plains]]).

== Washington, D.C. ==
[[File:FBI Washington Office by Matthew Bisanz.jpg|thumb|[[Washington, D.C.]] field office]]

* '''[[Washington, D.C.]]''': Serves all of the District of Columbia and the Navy Annex, plus the Virginia counties of Fauquier, Arlington, Prince William, Fairfax (City and County) and Loudoun. It also serves cities and towns including Quantico, Warrenton, Falls Church, Alexandria, Manassas, Leesburg and Vienna. One resident agency, in [[Manassas, Virginia|Manassas]].
